Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Data Scientist
What is the opportunity?
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our Cyber Analytics team within the Security Solutions Data Science organization. This role is critical to driving advanced analytics initiatives, improving fraud detection capabilities, and supporting strategic decision-making across cybersecurity and payment fraud domains.
What will you do?
• Gain subject matter knowledge on web application security, commonly exploited cyber vulnerabilities, and methods of online and payment card fraud including the common points of purchase for compromised cards.
• Build, develop, and maintain innovative data-driven analytical solutions, including predictive models and machine learning algorithms, on large volumes of data to support analytics and reporting needs across products, markets, and services.
• Competently handle large datasets, sifting for patterns and trends and translating those insights into technical rules and solutions.
• Combine cybersecurity and transaction data into new and insightful views of fraud and vulnerability across the Mastercard network.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and operations to understand product, usage, and data pipelines as well as delivering scalable solutions.
• Translate clients and stakeholder needs into technical analyses and/or solutions. Communicate results and business impacts of analytical insight to senior leadership and stakeholders.
• Design metrics to track product usage, model performance and other outcomes of interest, with the aim of increasing engagement and improving the security landscape.
All About You:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar fields.
• Strong work experience in data science, ideally in the payments- or cybersecurity-related industry.
• Experienced in building statistical and machine learning models in Python and working with large-scale distributed data processing frameworks, such as Apache Spark, Hadoop and Databricks.
• Experienced in data management and data mining with SQL, optimizing performance, building data pipelines, and quantitative analysis.
• Self-starter with passion for solving problems.
• High energy level; flexible, adaptive and strong collaborator.
• Well planned, organized & structured to manage time & work effectively.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Passion for cybersecurity and profound interest in learning new tools, threat vectors, attack techniques, technologies, and best practices in preventing cybersecurity incidents.
• Previous experience with graph database and graph machine learning including graph neural network.
Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.
THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 12/20/2026. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible.
Pay Ranges
New York City, New York: $110,000 - $176,000 USD

Title and Summary
Vice President, Software Engineering
Role Overview
Mastercard is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead the Developer Workbench, a strategic platform designed to deliver a unified, AI-enabled, end-to-end software engineering experience across the enterprise.
The Developer Workbench will bring together core engineering products, developer tools, AI-assisted coding capabilities, development environments, testing workflows, deployment pipelines, cloud development experiences, and developer insights into one cohesive platform. This leader will be accountable for transforming the Workbench from a set of disconnected tools and services into a productized developer experience that improves productivity, accelerates onboarding, increases adoption of modern engineering capabilities, and strengthens governance across the software development lifecycle.
This is a senior engineering leadership role for a builder, integrator, and enterprise change leader who can operate across product, engineering, architecture, security, finance, learning, and senior technology leadership.
________
Key Responsibilities
Lead the Developer Workbench Engineering Strategy
• Define and execute the engineering strategy for the Developer Workbench.
• Establish the technical architecture, operating model, and roadmap for a unified developer platform.
• Integrate developer tooling, engineering workflows, quality systems, AI coding capabilities, cloud and local development environments, and developer insights into a seamless end-to-end experience.
• Ensure the platform is scalable, secure, reliable, measurable, and aligned with enterprise engineering standards.
Build a Unified Developer Experience
• Create a frictionless developer journey from onboarding through coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
• Reduce manual setup, inconsistent tooling, and duplicated effort across engineering teams.
• Partner with product teams to integrate capabilities across the MSBX product suite, and other engineering platforms.
• Establish feedback mechanisms to continuously understand developer needs and improve the overall experience.
Drive AI-Native Engineering Capabilities
• Lead the adoption and integration of AI-assisted software engineering tools and agentic development capabilities.
• Define governance, security, usage, enablement, and measurement models for AI coding assistants.
• Partner with security, risk, compliance, and architecture teams to ensure responsible and secure use of AI across the software development lifecycle.
• Measure the effectiveness of AI-enabled development through adoption, productivity, quality, and developer satisfaction metrics.
Own Tooling Governance and Platform Stewardship
• Establish a governance model for developer tools.
• Manage tooling standards, lifecycle, versioning, adoption, enablement, and rationalization.
• Ensure that developer tools are maintained, current, secure, and consistently supported.
• Partner with finance and technology leaders to provide transparency into tool value, adoption, cost, and productivity impact.
Build and Lead a High-Performing Engineering Organization
• Recruit, develop, and lead a team of engineers, architects, platform specialists, technical program leaders, and developer experience professionals.
• Build a culture of customer obsession, engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure the team operates as a product organization with clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and strong stakeholder engagement.
• Develop talent and leadership capacity within the MSBX organization.
Partner Across the Enterprise
• Collaborate with CTOs, engineering leaders, product leaders, security, architecture, operations, finance, and learning teams.
• Influence senior stakeholders and align investment decisions with business value.
• Communicate strategy, progress, risks, and outcomes to executive audiences.
• Represent the Developer Workbench as a strategic enabler of modern software engineering at Mastercard.
________
Required Qualifications
• 15+ years of progressive software engineering experience.
• 8+ years of experience leading large engineering teams or platform engineering organizations.
• Proven experience building or scaling developer platforms, internal engineering platforms, DevEx organizations, cloud platforms, DevOps platforms, or engineering productivity functions.
• Strong understanding of modern software development practices, CI/CD, cloud-native architecture, platform engineering, developer tooling, quality engineering, and secure software delivery.
• Experience leading complex enterprise technology transformations in a matrixed environment.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and align cross-functional stakeholders.
• Strong track record of building high-performing teams and developing engineering leaders.
• Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to improve engineering productivity and platform adoption.
________
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with AI-assisted software development tools and emerging agentic engineering workflows.
• Experience integrating developer tools across IDEs, source control, CI/CD, testing, deployment, observability, and cloud environments.
• Background in developer experience, platform engineering, SRE, DevOps, cloud engineering, or engineering enablement.
• Experience supporting large-scale developer communities in a global enterprise.
• Familiarity with engineering productivity measurement, developer satisfaction metrics, and platform adoption frameworks.
• Experience managing tooling governance, vendor platforms, and enterprise-wide technology standards.
________
Leadership Attributes
The successful candidate will be:
• A visionary platform builder who can turn strategy into execution.
• A developer advocate who understands engineers as customers.
• A systems thinker who can simplify fragmented experiences.
• A strong technical leader who can operate at both architecture and executive levels.
• A change agent who can drive adoption across a large enterprise.
• A pragmatic operator who balances innovation, governance, cost, and delivery.
• A collaborative leader who builds trust across product, engineering, finance, security, and executive stakeholders.
• A metrics-driven leader focused on measurable business and developer outcomes.
